A small release that gets mieruka ready for package managers.

- `CLICOLOR_FORCE=1` keeps colors in `mieruka check` and `mieruka context` output when it isn't printed to a terminal, for example in CI logs. `NO_COLOR` still turns colors off and wins over it.
- The crate now includes the built web UI, so `cargo install mieruka` gets the full app once it is on crates.io.
- Manifests for Homebrew and winget are in the repository and are generated from each release's checksums.

The app itself works as in 0.2.0.

## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | `mieruka-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `mieruka-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| macOS, Intel | `mieruka-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| Linux x64 | `mieruka-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz` |

Each archive holds one binary and the license. `SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums.

The binaries are not signed yet. On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine mieruka` once after unpacking; on Windows, SmartScreen may ask you to confirm the first start.
